objects.description: During [C0018](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0018), the threat actors used [AvosLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1053) ransomware to encrypt files on the compromised network.(Citation: Cisco Talos Avos Jun 2022)(Citation: Costa AvosLocker May 2022)
